**Exciting news: Seatbelt v3 is officially released!**  
🛡️

I’m thrilled to share the newest version of **Seatbelt v3**, a free skill that empowers non‑developers to create and launch apps safely with AI, without writing a single line of code.

👉 **What’s new in v3?**  
- **Simplified drag‑and‑drop interface**: Design app workflows visually and let Seatbelt auto‑generate clean, production‑ready code.  
- **Built‑in AI safety checks**: Every prompt is vetted against the latest safety guidelines, so your app never ends up doing something it shouldn’t.  
- **One‑click deployment**: Instantly push your app to Google Cloud, Azure or AWS with zero configuration.  
- **Rich annotation support**: Add comments, documentation and test cases in the same interface.  
- **Community‑approved templates**: Start from a library of proven app templates and customize them to your needs.

🚀 **Why it matters**  
Most people want to harness the power of AI for their business, but they’re stuck on coding. Seatbelt removes the barrier, letting creatives, marketers and entrepreneurs focus on value‑adding tasks while we handle the technical details.

💡 **And the best part? It’s free** – no subscription, no hidden fees. Just a straightforward, open‑source tool that anyone can use to prototype and launch.

Want to see it in action? Check out the demo at **seatbelt.ai/v3** or just ping me for a quick walkthrough. Let’s build the next generation of AI‑powered apps together!
